intent: Implement the admitted one-shot SADHANA Mission Control bootstrap. Securely read and pin the exact external contract bytes, validate the closed ten-goal schema and acyclic dependency graph before canonical owners are opened, preflight all existing mission/task state before effects, resume only exact dependency-closed partial state, seed missing tasks in deterministic topological order through MissionControl idempotency, and emit a byte-stable mapping with an explicitly authority-unbound G05 canary.

negative_controls.name: seeded-state-cannot-promote-itself-to-dispatch-ready
negative_controls.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess,sys; p=Path('dharma_swarm/mission_control_bootstrap.py'); t=p.read_text(); old='\"dispatch_ready\": False'; assert old in t; p.write_text(t.replace(old, '\"dispatch_ready\": True', 1)); sys.exit(subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-q', 'tests/test_mission_control_bootstrap.py', '-k', 'output_never_claims_dispatch_ready'], check=False).returncode)"

interface_mismatches: TaskBoard allocates opaque task IDs; stable MissionControl idempotency keys make retries converge, while the emitted sorted mapping is the only supported goal-to-task join for later authority binding.

Mission and task owners use separate databases; the initializer cannot be globally atomic, so exact dependency-closed partial state is resumable and every conflicting or non-closed state is rejected before the initializer invokes another owner mutation.

The supervisor owns mission_campaign runtime sessions and dispatch requires separately verified roster, workspace, action, correlation, and zero-dollar lease authority; this initializer must not create either and therefore reports dispatch_ready=false with authority_unbound.

The contract file is external runtime input; secure exact-byte validation binds the task projections to one immutable digest without making the file, its prose, or task existence an authority or acceptance receipt.
honest_blockers: Seeded tasks are intentionally undispatchable until a separate admitted authority binder consumes this output and an explicit pinned roster, writes zero-dollar task-bound leases with exact relative workspace paths and both required Mission Control actions, and binds matching task metadata idempotently.

The follow-up binder must reconcile crashes across task creation, lease publication, and metadata binding without accepting drift or duplicating index events; this packet neither defines nor writes those authority effects.
A bootstrap lock serializes this one-shot CLI only; it cannot fence unrelated direct writers or turn TaskBoard and RuntimeStateStore into one transaction.

Exact contract bytes, mission/task existence, deterministic mapping, and canary identity prove configuration only—not process liveness, transport delivery, model execution, useful output, independent acceptance, promotion, merge, or deployment.
No host service unit, deployment, supervisor start, campaign runtime session, provider call, external contact, or network write is performed or proven by this repository slice.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the bootstrap module, one-shot CLI, focused tests, and this packet. Repository rollback does not delete already seeded canonical mission/tasks; those projections remain authority-unbound and require an explicit runtime cleanup warrant if removal is desired.
